## Workload

During the quarter, grader Marcus Bell completed 1060 reads across 480 hours. This represents 2.2 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review alongside the quality findings, providing a basis for considering both the volume of work completed and the consistency of the grading process. The current session pattern was also considered as part of the review. No change to that pattern was proposed.

## Quality

A total of 84 reads were checked by reviewer Priya Anand. The level of agreement between the grader’s assessments and the review findings was 77.4 per cent. The results were discussed by Marcus Bell and Priya Anand, who agreed to keep the current session pattern. The review therefore records the existing arrangement as continuing, with the workload and agreement figures retained for ongoing monitoring.
